findings.title: Missing validation on `fromViewInfo` input
findings.description: The `parse` function uses `value[1]` as a buffer index without strictly checking that `value[1]` is a valid reference within the `values` array.
steps_to_exploit: Craft a malicious JSON payload where `value[1]` points to an index outside of `values` or points to an incompatible type.
The `fromViewInfo` operation will attempt to construct a view using a non-buffer type.
findings.impact: Unexpected runtime errors or type confusion in the target runtime.

findings.title: Missing validation of `byteOffset` and `length` in View creation
findings.description: The `fromViewInfo` method trusts the `byteOffset` and `length` values provided by the serialized input when calling the TypedArray constructor.
steps_to_exploit: Construct a malformed payload where the `byteOffset` plus `length` exceeds the size of the underlying buffer.
The TypedArray constructor will throw a range error, which might be caught or handled improperly in the parent routine.
findings.impact: Denial of Service through unhandled exceptions.
